images.title: Why do the two states differ?
images.purpose: Shows that Punjab's temperature rises about 19 degrees in a year and Kerala's only about 4, raising the question why.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Two vertical range bars side by side on one temperature scale, with one question below.
images.exact_structure: One vertical temperature scale on the left with unlabelled ticks every 5 degrees from 15 to 40. Two vertical bars stand on the same scale, side by side with a wide gap: a tall vermilion (#D55E00) bar from about 19 to about 38 labelled Punjab under it, with the tag about 19 degrees beside it; a short teal (#0072B2) bar from about 29 to about 33 labelled Kerala under it, with the tag about 4 degrees beside it. A large reddish purple (#CC79A7) question tag between and below the bars reads Why so different?
